load_normalization: Linear elasticity: physical fields scaled to 1000 N for learning.
metrics: Unweighted surface-node vector relative L2 and mean top-seat vertical displacement relative error; not volumetric/energy/stress error.
sampling_caveat: Existing 64 combine 48 inner-domain and 16 wider-domain samples; new 64 cover wider domain. Nested practical expansion, not an iid scaling law.
test_policy: 32 fresh fixed geometries never used for epochs, settings or model selection; original 12 tests remain outside this study.
